item.title: Final project launch + critical making

learningObjectives.item: Write a final project proposal with a fabrication plan and timeline
Position your work relative to critical debates about making

item.content:
Final project brief (student-defined, theme-driven); proposal presentations; critical perspectives on digital fabrication.

Ideas

Critical making (Ratto); the maker movement and its critics (Morozov); open hardware, sharing files, and the politics of making; sustainability.

In class

  • Lecture/discussion (50)
  • proposal pitches (80)
  • planning (40)
